decisions.reason: A waterproof lined safety shoe range sits at the core of the firm's established offer in a growing industry, so its results likely meet the aspiration, and the firm's slack lets it carry the range despite missing website evidence after 2019.
Electrostatic-dissipative occupational shoes are a standard requirement in industrial work and close to the firm's competencies, so a shortfall that would trigger problemistic search is unlikely.
Safety shoe series are often refreshed, but with growing industry turnover and no sign of underperformance, management has little reason to drop this series within the coming year.
